description: Searches 7,600+ sealed products (booster boxes, Elite Trainer Boxes, booster bundles, tins, blisters, decks, collections, cases, accessories) for Pokemon, Japanese Pokemon, One Piece, Lorcana and Riftbound. Each row has its `type`, its daily prices (`cardmarket` = lowest listed price on Cardmarket, `tcgplayer` = TCGplayer market price; a price older than 7 days is left out) and `cardmarket_offers` (true when flipzi_get_sealed_cardmarket has offer figures). Asking prices, not sales: sealed products have no eBay sold prices here. Requires the pro plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit.

priced.description: true: only products with a current price.

q.description: Words in the product name, each prefix-matched, e.g. "destined rivals".

type.description: Product type, e.g. elite_trainer_box or booster_box.

name: flipzi_search_sealed
